import gzip,io
for tail in [b'',b'abc']:
 buffer=io.BytesIO()
 writer=gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=buffer,mode='wb',mtime=0)
 writer.flush()
 writer.flush()
 writer.write(tail)
 writer.close()
 print(gzip.decompress(buffer.getvalue()))

Source:
import io,gzip
try:
 import time
 now=int(time.time())
 value=int.from_bytes(gzip.compress(b"hi")[4:8],"little")
 print(abs(value-now)<=2,value==0)
except Exception as e: print(type(e).__name__)
